scripts.check:workspace: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build: npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
scripts.build:android:integration:apk: export NODE_ENV=production CLEVER_DRIVER_ISOLATED_ANDROID=true EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_ISOLATED_VERIFICATION=true EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_OPERATIONAL_ENABLED=true EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_API_BASE_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_API_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:4908} CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1 && node scripts/prebuild-android.mjs integration && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --max-workers=1 -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs='-Xmx2048m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1g' -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:android:release:apk: unset CLEVER_DRIVER_ISOLATED_ANDROID EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_ISOLATED_VERIFICATION EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_OPERATIONAL_ENABLED EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_API_BASE_URL && export NODE_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_DSV_OPERATIONAL_ENABLED=true && node scripts/prebuild-android.mjs release && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs='-Xmx2048m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1g' -PreactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a
